reconciliation.method: Read-only repeatable-read snapshot after the real close/finalization barrier; compare every bounded submitted key and receipt choice against rows, then compare final aggregate totals and option counts. Unknown absence is not loss of a confirmed vote.

limitations: Read-only audit of retained artificial keys; does not elect a leader, fence a primary, finalize a poll or certify a failure-zone model.

Without a positive explicit standby policy this audits only the observed copy. An explicit policy requires a fixed direct primary endpoint and verifies repository Results plus its WAL proof after the per-key snapshot.
